product_intent: Build the playable vertical slice of The Prismatic Creature Battler: a living holographic creature card collection and 6v6 Refractive Resonance auto-battler.
audience: Tactical auto-battler and collectible card players who want deep synergy engineering and museum-grade living foil cards without pay-to-win distortion.
emotional_objective: Wonder when tilting a living prismatic card in the exhibition, intellectual mastery when wiring a 3-step Refractive Resonance chain, and kinetic awe when cards materialize onto the dimensional sanctuary arena and unleash a Prism Gauge Convergence.
creative_thesis: Every creature is a living collectible with multi-layer parallax and masked diffraction foil; every team is a causal Refractive Resonance circuit where marks, wards, and phase strikes chain across units; and every battle materializes cards onto a dimensional 3D-perspective sanctuary where player-engineered synergies ignite the Prism Gauge.
anti_generic_risk: Avoid washing an unmasked rainbow gradient over the whole card and calling it holographic.
Avoid disconnected unit abilities that fire independently without cross-creature causal chains.
Avoid flat 2D dashboard grids during battle; cards must materialize onto a dimensional sanctuary floor with clear frontline/backline depth.

style_world_dna.world: The Prismatic Sanctuary — an obsidian and celestial-gold reliquary where elemental and astral creatures are preserved inside refractive crystal matrices.
foil_materials: Prismatic Spectrum (iridescent micro-hex rainbow diffraction on scales and crystal wings)
Phantom Foil (near-black obsidian chrome with oil-slick violet/cyan highlights for void and eclipse creatures)
Relic Foil (embossed antique gold/platinum filigree with illuminated runes for ancient guardians)
style_world_dna.camera: Interactive 3D-tilt card inspection in Collection/Prep; 32-degree angled dimensional tabletop sanctuary in Battle.

reference_principles: From Founder Reference 1-3 (Crystal Dragon, Hex Diffraction Scales, Ryu Jade Spirit): Creature artwork is the centerpiece; foil diffraction is masked to scales, wings, and frame borders while keeping typography plates crisp and dark.
From Founder Reference 4-5 & 8 (Prismatic Spectrum, Phantom Foil, Relic Foil): Three distinct material shaders rather than a single generic rainbow overlay.
From Founder Reference 6 (Tempest Wyrm, Prismhart, Riftstalker): Causal 3-unit Refractive Resonance chain (Voltbrand -> Refractive Ward -> Phase Rend).
signature_moments: Tilting a creature card in the Collection Studio and watching the micro-hex Prismatic Spectrum, dark Phantom Chrome, or embossed Relic Gold shift across its wings and border while veins and eyes pulse.

Watching Tempest Wyrm apply Voltbrand to an enemy frontline, immediately triggering adjacent Prismhart's Refractive Ward shield and opening a Void Rift for Riftstalker to Phase Rend the marked target.
Filling the shared Prism Gauge to 100% through Resonance reactions and unleashing an archetype-specific Convergence wave across the dimensional arena.
medium_candidates: ComfyUI FLUX.2 Klein 4B Distilled FP8 for original 1024x1024 painterly creature portraits and sanctuary environment art
Deterministic Studio Vision Pipeline for background extraction, trimming, contact sheets, sprite atlases, and breathing/combat animation sequences
Godot 4.7.2 + HTML5 Canvas2D/WebGL shader-driven runtime for real-time masked foil diffraction, 3D card tilt parallax, and 6v6 dimensional arena combat
resource_strategy: All 8 Founder-supplied images are cataloged as REFERENCE_ONLY_NOT_SHIPPED. All shipped creature portraits, spritesheets, atlases, and arena backgrounds are generated locally via FLUX.2 Klein 4B (Apache-2.0) and procedurally/shader-rendered.
evidence_plan: Schema validation for game-brief, art-bible, task-graph, production-project, asset-manifest, model-license, qa-report, review-record, and release-manifest
Contact sheets and animation audits for all 8 generated creatures
Godot 4.7.2 headless validation and Web export + live Chromium browser preview, interactive playtest verification, and captured screenshots
